text: Good evening ma. I am a childminder, the parents are delayed so I have baby Tobi with me, 5 months old boy. His temperature is 38 now. He vomited once around 7pm but since then he has been taking his milk and water and it is staying down, no more vomiting. I have checked his body well well, there is no rash anywhere, and his skin and lips are normal colour, nothing strange. Please I am so tired, I just want to know if I should be doing anything for the temperature or just keep watching him.
